tools.name: get_catalog_templates
tools.description:
Return the enabled ApplicationTemplate catalog, ordered by name. Call this to
discuss trial and template options with a prospect or customer before starting a
trial. If this doesn't answer your question, call `start_inquiry` to ask
4chems directly or request a call.

tools.name: list_consents
tools.description:
Return the caller's own recorded consents plus the tenant-scope consents of
every tenant where the caller is at least a viewer. Call this to check which legal
documents have already been accepted before asking again. Pass `tenant_id` to
list one tenant's consents only (a caller of several tenants mu

tools.name: record_consent
tools.description:
Record acceptance of a legal document version and return the entry; call this
only after showing the user the document URL and version and receiving an
explicit affirmative answer.

tools.name: start_inquiry
tools.description:
Store an anonymous inquiry draft and email a 6-digit verification code.
Ask the user for the code, then call verify_inquiry with the returned
challenge_id and code — the inquiry reaches 4chems only after that
verification succeeds.

tools.name: verify_inquiry
tools.description: Verify the 6-digit code and deliver the inquiry to the helpdesk inbox.

tools.name: accept_invitation
tools.description:
Accept a pending invitation and grant the invitee's first role assignment.
Call this when an invitee has a valid invite link and wants to join the
tenant; single-use, consuming the token marks it accepted.

tools.name: get_my_access
tools.description:
Return the caller's access level per related tenant. Call this to check
what the current caller is authorized to do before attempting an action
that requires a specific level, or to discover a pending invitation or
access request.

tools.name: create_access_request
tools.description: Request access to the tenant that owns the caller's verified email domain.

tools.name: approve_access_request
tools.description:
Approve a pending access request: issue a `member` invitation to the
requester and resolve the request (level `admin` or `owner` of the
request's tenant). The response carries the single-use invitation token
to hand to the requester, who accepts via `accept_invitation`. 409
`access_request.not_pendi

tools.name: dismiss_access_request
tools.description:
Dismiss a pending access request (level `admin` or `owner` of the
request's tenant). The requester is mailed — naming the tenant, never the
dismissing admin — and may ask again. 409 `access_request.not_pending`
unless the request is pending.

tools.name: withdraw_access_request
tools.description:
Withdraw the caller's own pending access request; no notification is
sent. Any other caller gets 404 `access_request.not_found`, the same as
for an unknown id. 409 `access_request.not_pending` unless pending.

tools.name: enrich_domain
tools.description: Fetch the caller's domain imprint and suggest legal-entity details (UC-057).

tools.name: start_device_login
tools.description:
Sign in to an existing account by device login (UC-091, RFC 8628). Anonymous,
empty body; the account must exist (start_account_registration, then set the
password through the emailed link). Show `verification_uri` (or
`verification_uri_complete`) and `user_code` to the human, who signs in there,
th

tools.name: verify_device_login
tools.description:
Poll a device login to token issuance (UC-091, RFC 8628). Anonymous. While
the human has not signed in yet it answers `{"status": "pending",
"retry_after": <seconds>}`: wait `retry_after` seconds and call again with the
same `challenge_id`. On approval it returns Keycloak's token set

tools.name: start_account_registration
tools.description:
Start registering a 4chems account with a business email address (`email`,
`name`, optional `company`). Anonymous. Emails a 6-digit code to the address;
no account exists yet. Ask the user for the code, then call
verify_account_registration with the returned challenge_id and code. Free-mail
addresse

tools.name: verify_account_registration
tools.description:
Verify the emailed 6-digit code (`challenge_id`, `code`) and create the
4chems account. Never guess or retry codes, and never ask the user for a
password.

tools.name: start_registration
tools.description: DEPRECATED: use start_device_login. Deprecated — use start_device_login (same behaviour).

tools.name: verify_registration
tools.description: DEPRECATED: use verify_device_login. Deprecated — use verify_device_login (same behaviour).

tools.name: get_onboarding_route
tools.description:
Return the next onboarding step. If this doesn't answer your question, call
`start_inquiry` to ask 4chems directly or request a call.

tools.name: create_self_service_tenant
tools.description:
Create a 7-day trial tenant for the caller's business email domain (UC-052).
Needs a verified email on a business domain and `attestation: true`; answers
`auth.email_not_verified`, `tenant.attestation_required`,
`tenant.free_mail_domain` (free-mail address), `tenant.domain_exists`
(a live trial tena

tools.name: get_my_operation
tools.description:
Return the status, result and error of an operation the caller started, such as
the `Location` of a `202` from `complete_billing`. Call this to poll it to completion.

tools.name: get_legal_entity_types
tools.description:
Return the legal-entity types available for *country*, ordered alphabetically.
If this doesn't answer your question, call `start_inquiry` to ask 4chems directly
or request a call.

tools.name: get_billing
tools.description:
Return the tenant's stored billing details: VAT id, invoice address, invoice
email and PO reference. Call this to check whether billing is complete; only
the owner and billing contacts may read it (`403 rbac.insufficient_level`).

tools.name: complete_billing
tools.description:
Complete the tenant's billing details: legal-entity name and type, VAT id,
invoice address, invoice email and optional PO reference. Call this when the
owner or a billing contact has the details. EU VAT ids are validated against
VIES by the worker; a failed operation with `billing.vat_check_unavaila

tools.name: list_invitations
tools.description:
List all invitations for the caller's tenant, most recent first. Call this to
show a tenant admin which invitations are pending, accepted, or revoked; the
raw token is never included.

tools.name: create_invitation
tools.description:
Invite an email address to the caller's tenant at the specified access
level and return the invitation, including the raw single-use accept
token. Call this when a tenant admin wants to add a new member; the
invitee accepts via `accept_invitation`.

tools.name: revoke_invitation
tools.description:
Revoke a pending invitation so its token can no longer be accepted. Call this
when a tenant admin wants to withdraw an invite sent by mistake or no longer
needed; accepted invitations cannot be revoked.

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List tenant members with their effective role x scope assignments.

tools.name: grant_assignment
tools.description: Grant a role x scope assignment to a tenant member.

tools.name: revoke_assignment
tools.description: Revoke a role x scope assignment from a tenant member.

tools.name: list_tenant_services
tools.description:
Return the caller's tenant's active service subscriptions. Call this before
offering to add a service, to check what is already subscribed.

tools.name: add_tenant_service
tools.description:
Request a new service subscription for the caller's tenant and return its
status. Call this when a tenant admin wants to add a service (ADR 0016
code fix: requires `admin`, was `customer` realm role only).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_billing · Private data: list_consents, record_consent, accept_invitation, approve_access_request, start_device_login, verify_device_login, verify_account_registration, get_billing, complete_billing, list_invitations, create_invitation, revoke_invitation · Public sink: start_inquiry, create_access_request, start_account_registration, create_self_service_tenant, get_billing, complete_billing, create_invitation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_billing · Private data: list_consents, record_consent, accept_invitation, approve_access_request, start_device_login, verify_device_login, verify_account_registration, get_billing, complete_billing, list_invitations, create_invitation, revoke_invitation · Public sink: start_inquiry, create_access_request, start_account_registration, create_self_service_tenant, get_billing, complete_billing, create_invitation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
